The Mirc Glow Korean glass skin kit is our full range in one box: three Korean-inspired creams that cover your morning and your night. Glass skin is the Korean term for skin that looks smooth, even and so well hydrated that it reflects light. It comes from steady, gentle moisturising, and this kit gives you the creams to do exactly that.

Bought as a kit, the three jars cost less than buying them one by one.

What is in the kit

1. Glutathione Cream with Vitamin C and Kojic Acid, 30 g. For a hydrated, smooth and radiant-looking finish. Used in the evening.

2. Avocado Korean Night Cream, 25 g. With avocado, aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid, for a softer, more even-looking complexion. Used in the evening.

3. Avocado Glow Nourishing Skin Cream, 10 g. A light avocado moisturiser for daytime, and a handy travel size.

What is glass skin?

Glass skin is not a skin colour and it is not make-up. It is a look: smooth texture, even-looking tone and a healthy, dewy finish. The idea comes from K-beauty, the Korean approach to skincare, which values hydration and patience over harsh quick fixes.

Every skin tone can have a glass skin look. What it needs is consistent moisture, gentle care and daily sun protection.

A note on the word Korean

Mirc Glow creams are Korean-inspired. They follow the K-beauty approach to texture and ingredients, such as layering-friendly creams and vitamin B3, and they are priced for everyday use in India. Please see each pack for manufacturing details.

How to use the Korean glass skin kit

Morning routine

  1. Rinse or cleanse lightly.
  2. Apply a small amount of Avocado Glow Nourishing Skin Cream.
  3. Finish with a broad-spectrum sunscreen of SPF 30 or higher.

Night routine

  1. Cleanse. Use an oil cleanser first if you wore sunscreen or make-up, then a gentle face wash.
  2. Pat in a hydrating toner, if you use one.
  3. Apply your night cream as the last step.

Which night cream, when?

Start by alternating. Use the Glutathione Cream one night and the Avocado Korean Night Cream the next. Both contain kojic acid, so alternating is the gentle way to begin.

Once your skin is comfortable, you can layer them on the same evening: a thin layer of Glutathione Cream first, then a thin layer of Avocado Korean Night Cream to seal it in.

Why these three creams work as a kit

  • Radiance. The Glutathione Cream brings antioxidant care with glutathione and vitamin C.
  • Nourishment. The Avocado Korean Night Cream gives a rich, cushioned layer for the night.
  • Daytime comfort. The Avocado Glow cream keeps skin soft under sunscreen.

Each cream has its own time and its own job, so nothing overlaps and nothing is wasted.

Key ingredients across the kit

  • Glutathione and vitamin C for a luminous look.
  • Kojic acid for a brighter, more even-looking tone.
  • Vitamin B3, also called niacinamide, for a smooth-looking surface.
  • Avocado and aloe vera for nourishment with a fresh feel.

Please check each pack for the full and current ingredient list. You can look up any ingredient in our skincare ingredient glossary.

Who is this kit for?

Beginners. If you are new to Korean-style skincare, the kit gives you a complete routine without having to choose products one by one.

Dull or uneven-looking skin. The two night creams are made for a brighter, more even look.

Dry and normal skin. Use the full amounts.

Oily and combination skin. Use thin layers and alternate the night creams.

Sensitive skin. Patch test each cream, and introduce them one at a time, a week apart.

The kit is suitable for both women and men, and it also makes a thoughtful gift.

Adjusting for Indian weather

Korean routines were designed for cold, dry winters. In India, use thinner layers in summer and during the monsoon, and fuller amounts in winter. Sunscreen is essential all year. Our article on the glass skin routine for Indian skin explains this in detail.

What to expect

First week. Skin feels softer and more hydrated.

Weeks four to eight. Skin looks smoother and fresher.

Weeks eight to twelve. A more even-looking tone becomes easier to see.

Glass skin is built gradually. Results vary from person to person and depend on consistent use and daily sunscreen.

How long does the kit last?

Alternating the two night creams, they last around two months together. The 10 g day cream lasts around two to three weeks of daily use.

Good to know

  • Wear sunscreen every morning. It matters most when your routine includes kojic acid.
  • Patch test before first use, and stop if irritation occurs.
  • Introduce one cream at a time.
  • Store the jars closed, away from heat and direct sunlight.
  • These are cosmetic products and are not intended to treat any skin condition.

Korean glass skin kit FAQs

What does the Korean glass skin kit include?

Three creams: the Glutathione Cream 30 g, the Avocado Korean Night Cream 25 g and the Avocado Glow Nourishing Skin Cream 10 g.

Can I use all three creams in one day?

Yes. Use the Avocado Glow cream in the morning and one or both night creams in the evening.

Is it made in Korea?

The creams are Korean-inspired. Please see each pack for manufacturing details.

How soon will I see a glass skin look?

Skin feels softer within days. A smoother, more even look usually takes eight to twelve weeks of steady use.

Is the kit cheaper than buying the creams separately?

Yes. The kit price is lower than the three creams bought individually.
